rationale: Both review tasks completed. The definitional reviewer found five load-bearing wording defects, but each has an exact source-bound replacement and requires no new exploration. Evidence closure therefore admits the writer only if every repair below is applied and audited.

mandatory_repairs.requirement: Label the opening as the author's accessible framing with voice approval, not as the canonical CAV2 definition; then bridge explicitly to the governed CAV2 meaning contract.
mandatory_repairs.required_language: Ontologies are knowledge spaces: bounded models of the part of a world a domain cares about. They contain selected concepts and typed relations—including interactions where those are evidenced—and carry time, confidence, provenance, lifecycle, and rules for use. That is my accessible framing; CyberAlchemy v2 adds the governed meaning contract.

mandatory_repairs.requirement: Do not anthropomorphize Inventory, ontology, context, memory, or authority as runtime actors. Name the selection, context-builder, owner, and runtime processes.
mandatory_repairs.required_retell_chain: Find candidate evidence. Type meaning. Bound context. Gate use.
mandatory_repairs.expanded_chain: owned source or event → Inventory or retrieval makes candidate evidence and selectors findable → explicit evidence selection → ontology-governed typed meaning, relations, time, confidence, and provenance → a context builder packages a bounded task view with warnings → a named authority owner permits or denies reliance → a separate workflow or runtime acts, asks, or stops

mandatory_repairs.requirement: State positively that an ontology may include a glossary and taxonomy and may be represented in a database or graph, but none of those structures alone supplies the governed meaning contract.
Use the full owner-gated ladder and keep governed ontology authority distinct from its projection or generated read model.
mandatory_repairs.required_ladder: source selector → Inventory evidence card or EvidenceSet → ontology candidate → owner-gated PromotionRecord → governed ontology node or artifact → projection or generated read model

mandatory_repairs.requirement: Do not present an ordered view sequence as literal relation direction. Show the actual typed Augmentor semantics and render the final relation as a request into an external named-owner gate, not production of a decision.
At first reveal only a genuine dated record marked approved. Hide expiry, supersession, and current owner decision until the replay.
Author the nominal performance to finish by 14:15-14:20 and protect the Augmentor authority edge, audience retell, and final sentence from cuts.
Keep DomainSpec and Body War as witness insets in one persistent visual scene; reduce Body War spoken content to one lifecycle transition, two confidence bases, and one non-promotion edge.
Introduce Augmentor in plain language as the concrete attempt to give agents bounded context without letting retrieved material become authority; keep internal identifiers authoring-only.

load_bearing_claims.ceiling: not a replacement canonical definition and not a complete truth model
does not prove durable memory, reasoning, routing, or authorization
does not prove workflow, live scoring, promotion, release, or production
authority_effect none; release not granted; no working routing, durable memory, reasoning, promotion, release, or production claim

augmentor_drift.claim_ceiling: Concurrent byte changes mean this is not owner acceptance, lifecycle reconciliation, promotion, or stable release evidence. Source JSON views remain the authoring basis.

writer_gate.condition: Writer must apply EC-01 through EC-09 exactly and keep projected, spoken, notes, and authoring metadata distinct. Auditor must bind its verdict to this file.
